name: British Sign Language
family: BANZSL (British, Australian and New Zealand Sign Language)
alphabet_description: BSL uses a distinctive two-handed fingerspelling alphabet. Vowels are formed by placing the index finger of the dominant hand onto the fingers of the non-dominant hand (Thumb=A, Index=E, Middle=I, Ring=O, Little finger=U). Consonants use specific two-handed touch points.

alphabet.description: Dominant index finger touches the tip of non-dominant thumb.
Both hands form circles with thumb and index fingers, touching tips to form an 8-like B shape.
Dominant hand forms curved C shape between thumb and fingers.
Non-dominant index points straight up; dominant index and thumb form curved arch touching index tip and base.
Dominant index finger touches the tip of non-dominant index finger.
Dominant index and middle fingers rest horizontally across non-dominant index and middle fingers.
alphabet.tip: Two pairs of crossed horizontal fingers

alphabet.description: Both hands closed into fists placed together with dominant fist resting on top of non-dominant fist.
Non-dominant palm held flat upward; dominant flat palm strokes across it from wrist to fingertips.
Dominant index finger touches the tip of non-dominant middle finger.
Dominant index touches tip of non-dominant middle finger (I), then curves downward across palm toward wrist.
alphabet.tip: Hook tracing down from vowel I

alphabet.description: Non-dominant index points up; dominant index finger hooks sideways touching first knuckle of non-dominant index.
Non-dominant palm held open flat; dominant index finger rests flat across center of palm.
alphabet.tip: Single finger lying across open palm

alphabet.description: Dominant three fingers (index, middle, ring) rest across palm of non-dominant flat hand.
Dominant two fingers (index, middle) rest across palm of non-dominant flat hand.
Dominant index finger touches the tip of non-dominant ring finger.
Non-dominant index points upright; dominant thumb and index form closed circle touching index tip.
Non-dominant hand forms circle with thumb and index; dominant index hooks into base of circle.
Dominant index finger hooks like a claw and rests on non-dominant flat palm.
Little fingers of both hands hooked tightly together at chest level.
Dominant index finger touches bottom edge of non-dominant open flat hand near wrist/thumb.
alphabet.tip: Index touching edge of flat palm

alphabet.description: Dominant index finger touches the tip of non-dominant pinky finger.
Dominant index and middle fingers in V shape placed onto non-dominant flat palm.
Both hands open with fingers spread, interlocking and angled forward.
Index fingers of both hands crossed over each other forming an X.
Non-dominant thumb and index form V shape; dominant index finger rests between them in the crotch.
Non-dominant flat palm held outward; dominant fist held behind it touches palm with side of hand.

vocabulary.label: HELLO
vocabulary.description: Open hand held by side of head waving or moving forward in a polite palm salute.

vocabulary.label: GOODBYE
vocabulary.description: Open hand raised at shoulder level oscillating or waving fingers downward.

vocabulary.label: THANK_YOU
vocabulary.description: Fingers of dominant flat hand touch chin and move forward toward other person.
vocabulary.hand_orientation: palm facing signer at chin, then tilts forward

vocabulary.label: PLEASE
vocabulary.description: Flat dominant hand moves smoothly down or rubs palm on chest in polite request.

vocabulary.label: HELP
vocabulary.description: Dominant flat hand supports the non-dominant closed fist or arm, lifting upwards together.

vocabulary.label: NAME
vocabulary.description: Dominant 'H' (index & middle) fingers tap across non-dominant 'H' fingers twice.

vocabulary.label: YES
vocabulary.description: Closed fist with wrist flexing up and down mimicking a head nod.

vocabulary.label: NO
vocabulary.description: Both open hands with palms downward cross over and push outward decisively.

numbers.description: Dominant index finger pointing straight up, palm facing signer.
Dominant index and middle fingers pointing straight up, palm facing signer.
Dominant index, middle, and ring fingers pointing up, palm facing signer.
Four fingers pointing straight up, thumb tucked across palm, facing signer.
All five fingers spread open, palm facing signer.
Non-dominant open 5 hand; dominant index finger touches non-dominant thumb.
Non-dominant open 5 hand; dominant index and middle touch non-dominant palm.
Non-dominant open 5 hand; dominant three fingers touch non-dominant palm.
Non-dominant open 5 hand; dominant four fingers touch non-dominant palm.
Both hands open with all 10 fingers spread facing forward.
